item.title: 7,000 square feet! Circa 1912 in Kansas. $285,000
item.description: This is a huge house with 7,000 square feet! There are some nice details inside! The house was built in 1912. It is located on .47 acre in Larned, Kansas. The house features an expansive front porch, balcony, leaded glass, a grand staircase, vintage light fixtures, pocket doors, exposed beams, stained glass and built-in bookshelves. There are a lot of possibilities with this house. There is a detached three car garage on the property. Six bedrooms, four bathrooms and 7,000 square feet. $285,000

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! C. 1933. Almost an acre in North Carolina. $98,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! Looks livable too, so someone could move in and work room by room. The house was built in 1933. It is located on .94 acre in Winston Salem, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, a screened in porch, wood floors, crystal chandelier, baseboards, crown moulding, brick hearth, built-in bookshelves and a telephone nook. item.title: Real pretty area! C. 1920. Almost three acres in Virginia. $125,900
item.description: This is such a pretty area of Virginia. We drive through there on our way to and from Saltville, Virginia. The house was built in 1920. It is located on 2.93 acres in Stuart, Virginia. This is the type of house where you could move in and work room by room. The house features a covered front porch, some original wood flooring and baseboards. There is a stream on the property. item.title: Circa 1795. The Titus Christian House in Kentucky. $231,900
item.description: The Titus Christian House. Love that chimney. The Titus Christian House was built in 1795. It is located in Bardstown, Kentucky. The house features wood floors, exposed beams, baseboards and nice fireplaces. The kitchen has been updated. There is a fenced backyard, outdoor fireplace and a detached storage shed on the property. A bit disappointed with the interior. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,152 square feet. $231,900 Contact Mike Ballard with Area One Realty: 502-510-0515 From the Zillow li

item.title: This has potential! Circa 1919. One acre in Louisiana. $74,900
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! The home was built in 1919. It is located on one acre in Mansura, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, pocket doors, wide baseboards, crown moulding and picture rails. The lot is nice with mature trees and there is a detached garage. item.title: Near local beaches! Cute cottage! Over an acre in Maine. $195,000
item.description: This is a cute cottage! Listing says it is near local beaches and amenities. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 1.2 acres in Jonesboro, Maine. The house features a front porch, wide plank wood floors, exposed beams, a lot of natural light, cute kitchen, nice stove, knotty pine and vaulted ceilings. The home was recently moved back from the road and placed on a concrete basement. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 756 square feet. $195,000 Contact Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate/The

item.title: In a quaint village near the Chesapeake Bay. Circa 1920 in Maryland. $115,000
item.description: This is a cute house! It is situated in a quaint village near the Chesapeake Bay. The house was built in 1920. It is located on .31 acre in the Village of Rhodes Point on Smith Island in Ewell, Maryland. The house features a white picket fence, original wood floors and some crown moulding. There is a detached storage shed on the property. item.title: Look at those wide plank floors! Park Holland House, C. 1810 in Massachusetts. $299,900
item.description: How about those wide floor boards! They are beautiful! This house has a lot of potential! It is known as the Park Holland House. The first owner was the owner of the Belchertown Carriage Manufacturer. The house was built in 1810. It is located on .81 acre in Belchertown, Massachusetts. The house features wide plank wood floors, amazing front door with original hardware, chair rails, spacious kitchen, baseboards and coffered ceiling. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,172 square feet. $299,900 C

item.title: Love this! Student of Frank Lloyd Wright designed this home. 21 acres in Michigan. $599,900
item.description: I love this house! It was designed by a student of Frank Lloyd Wright. Love the pond and apparently there is a waterfall. The house was built in 1945. It is located on 21.7 acres in Jackson, Michigan. The house features a wall of windows, beautiful stained glass, soaring ceilings, brick accent wall and a really spacious kitchen. item.title: Check out that attic! Circa 1900 in Mississippi. $299,900
item.description: Check out that attic! Have never seen an attic ceiling that tall! The house was built in 1900. It is located in Water Valley, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, great back patio, original wood floors, built-ins, tall ceilings, stained glass, picture rails, transom windows, wide baseboards, large bathroom, crown moulding and a great kitchen.
